cases.say: The front washes out when I turn in to the hairpin
Car pushes wide in the middle of the long sweeper
It won't rotate and runs wide when I get on the throttle out of the corner
The rear steps out as soon as I brake and turn in
Back end snaps loose when I punch the throttle exiting
The car wants to roll over on the inside wheels in fast direction changes
It skips and gets twitchy over the bumps on the straight
How do I tune my nitro engine needle?
What charge rate should I use for my LiPo pack?
The car feels nervous turning in and the rear is loose off the corner
